stem.text: A sample of an ideal gas is contained at a constant temperature of 300 K in a gas syringe.
The pressure is increased and a graph of $\dfrac{pV}{RT}$ against pressure is plotted.
Which graph correctly represents the results?

stem.alt: Graph of pV/RT (y-axis) against p (x-axis). Four lines start from the same point on the y-axis: A rises as a straight line, B dips slightly then rises as a curve, C is horizontal, D falls as a straight line. The lines are labelled A, B, C and D.
